response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT s.transref AS transreg, tr.ordertypedist AS ordertypedist, AVG(s.shortintrt) AS avg_si, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_ov, SUM(s.shortintrt) AS sum_si, COUNT(s.shortintrt) AS cnt_si FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = s.transref GROUP BY s.transref, tr.ordertypedist), g AS (SELECT transreg, ordertypedist, avg_si, avg_ov, SUM(sum_si) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(cnt_si) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist), 0) AS grp_avg FROM t) SELECT transreg AS transaction_reference, ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, avg_si AS avg_short_interest, avg_ov AS avg_option_volume_ratio, avg_si / NULLIF(grp_avg, 0) AS short_interest_ratio FROM g ORDER BY (avg_si / NULLIF(grp_avg, 0)) IS NULL, avg_si / NULLIF(grp_avg, 0) DESC LIMIT 10
